name: ECOSHOP
recent: Eco-Shop 在 2026 年 11 月 4 日举行第 12 届常年股东大会及特别股东大会，所有决议均获通过，包括设立新的 ESOS 及委任 Deloitte 为新核数师。公司于 11 月 10 日因员工行使 ESOS 而发行 1,006,230 股新股，并于 11 月 11 日上市。EPF 在 11 月持续申报持股变动，同时董事 Dato' Sri Lee Kar Whatt 于 10 月底在公开市场增持股份。
notable: 第 12 届常年股东大会及特别股东大会于 2026 年 11 月 4 日举行，所有决议均获通过，包括设立新的员工认股计划 (ESOS) 及委任 Deloitte 为新核数师。
因员工行使 ESOS，公司于 2026 年 11 月 10 日发行 1,006,230 股新股，并于 11 月 11 日上市。
董事 Dato' Sri Lee Kar Whatt 于 2026 年 10 月 29 日及 30 日在公开市场间接增持共 8,444,000 股。
risks: EPF 在 2026 年 11 月多次申报持股变动，显示主要股东持股出现变化。
董事及主要人员在 2026 年 11 月有多笔证券交易申报，包括 ESOS 行使及公开市场交易。
公司于 2026 年 10 月 28 日触及四个月低点，此前第一季业绩低于预期。
earnings: 2026 年 8 月 31 日止季度，营收为 RM793.678 百万，环比增长 2.7%，同比增长 15.2%；净利为 RM63.192 百万，环比下降 13.0%，同比增长 26.1%；净利率为 8.0%，低于上一季度的 9.4%。

recent_en: Eco-Shop held its 12th AGM and an EGM on 4 November 2026, where all resolutions were passed, including the establishment of a new ESOS and the appointment of Deloitte as the new auditor. The company issued 1,006,230 new shares on 10 November 2026 due to ESOS exercises, which were listed on 11 November 2026. EPF continued to file changes in its shareholdings in November, while Director Dato' Sri Lee Kar Whatt acquired shares in the open market in late October.
notable_en: The 12th AGM and EGM were held on 4 November 2026, with all resolutions passed, including the establishment of a new ESOS and the appointment of Deloitte as the new auditor.
The company issued 1,006,230 new shares on 10 November 2026 due to ESOS exercises, which were listed on 11 November 2026.
Director Dato' Sri Lee Kar Whatt indirectly acquired a total of 8,444,000 shares in the open market on 29 and 30 October 2026.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple changes in its shareholdings in November 2026, indicating changes in major shareholder holdings.
There were multiple filings of securities dealings by directors and key personnel in November 2026, including ESOS exercises and open market transactions.
The company hit a four-month low on 28 October 2026 following a first-quarter earnings miss.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM793.678 million, up 2.7% QoQ and 15.2% YoY; net income was RM63.192 million, down 13.0% QoQ but up 26.1% YoY; net margin was 8.0%, lower than 9.4% in the previous quarter.
